# FPSOT vocabularies specification

> How FPSOT projects publish controlled vocabularies as W3C SKOS concept schemes: stable URIs and codes, English and French labels, hierarchy, deprecation and versions, mappings, Turtle, JSON-LD and CSV files, and LinkML bindings.

## Specification

- [Overview](spec/en/index.adoc): scope, parts, conformance and references.
- [Schemes, concepts and codes](spec/en/identity.adoc): VOC-001 to VOC-008.
- [Labels and definitions](spec/en/labels.adoc): VOC-010 to VOC-016.
- [Hierarchy and collections](spec/en/hierarchy.adoc): VOC-020 to VOC-025.
- [Lifecycle and versions](spec/en/lifecycle.adoc): VOC-030 to VOC-037.
- [Mappings](spec/en/mappings.adoc): VOC-040 to VOC-044.
- [Publishing](spec/en/publishing.adoc): VOC-050 to VOC-055.
- [Binding in data models](spec/en/binding.adoc): VOC-060 to VOC-065.

## Guide and model

- [Publish a vocabulary of document types](docs/modules/en/pages/index.adoc)
- [Example scheme in Turtle](model/document-types.ttl)
- [Example LinkML binding](model/document-types.yaml)
